mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 34 degrees with clear skies by the Military Ridge State Trail and a waning crescent moon overhead.

The City of Verona Plan Commission meets on Monday, December 7th, to review development projects, including a site plan and traffic impact analysis for the Sub-Zero facility in the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, residents are encouraged to stay updated on city maintenance and programs by subscribing to the official digital newsletter.

There is plenty to do in Verona starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company or head to the Capitol Square for the Dane County Farmers' Market.
In a report regarding noteworthy calls, on October 25th, police responded to a vehicle stopped at an intersection for over 20 minutes and arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich Chocolate Volcano. The Culver's of Verona location opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
